info.title: TradeStocker local API
info.description: The API platform-core actually serves (PAPER workspace, SEC research, health). Every route here is routed, and every route the server registers is here (checked by tests). There is no order-submission, trade-execution or broker endpoint: fill and sell record executions a human already made. Schemas use the TradeStocker schema subset (contracts/README.md). Money is integer minor units (exact; no fractions exist in PAPER); the SEC report's decimals are strings.

ownerToken.description: The per-installation TS_LOCAL_DEV_TOKEN (a single-owner development stand-in, not production identity).

traceparent.description: W3C trace context of this request (continued or new).

Timestamp.description: UTC instant (Go RFC 3339 with Z, 0 to 9 fraction digits).

Money.description: Exact integer in minor currency units (cents, piastres). Not a decimal: paper money never has a fraction of a minor unit.

SignedMoney.description: Exact integer change in minor currency units.

Symbol.description: A ticker as given. The paper API does not resolve instrument identity and does not check the length; a symbol is bounded only by the 64 KiB request body.

Error.description: Every 4xx/5xx answer. The message is for people; act on the code.

checks.description: One fixed word per dependency (postgres, nats); never error text.

state.description: Every lane is DISABLED; stored state with another value is refused.

assessment_id.description: Empty when no financial evidence exists.

assessment.description: The quote's assessment ID (may be empty); present when a quote exists.

observation.description: The quote's observation time; present when a quote exists.

status.description: Acknowledged is not filled; FILLED means a human recorded a past paper execution.

AuditDetail.description: A short note, or an object with the action's fields. Every field is typed; unknown fields are refused.

symbol.description: Research stub input, bounded only by the 64 KiB body limit.

accounts.description: The server sets no limit on this list.

quotes.description: The server sets no limit on this list.

recommendations.description: The server sets no limit on this list.

positions.description: The server sets no limit on this list.

audit.description: The server sets no limit on this list.

notifications.description: The server sets no limit on this list.

journal.description: The server sets no limit on this list.

Dashboard.description: The whole PAPER workspace as stored; private idempotency receipts are never included.

RiskPolicy.description: An unapproved paper test fixture, not an approved risk policy.

amount_minor.description: Synthetic paper funds in minor units.

RecordPaperFill.description: Records that the human already executed this paper decision at price_minor. Nothing is sent to a broker.

RecordPaperSell.description: Records a past human paper sale of shares the account holds. Nothing is sent to a broker.

result.description: The stored report once SUCCEEDED; omitted in the list.

detail.description: The fields of the action; every field is typed.

events.description: At most 17 can exist: REQUESTED, up to five per attempt for three attempts, and WORKER_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED.

SecOriginal.description: The stored SEC original, byte for byte, as SEC published it.
